data.description:
## Summary
Introduce the 2D street-cell grid model and world-coordinate resolver that replaces the flat 10-slot `GRID_SIZE` assumption. This is the vertical slice that makes the topology real and keeps 1×1 games identical.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `MainStreetConstants.ts` exposes per-street dimensions (`STREET_COLS=5`, `STREET_ROWS=2` preserved) plus grid dimensions (`STREET_GRID_COLS`, `STREET_GRID_ROWS` default 1×1 with config to grow to ≥3×3) and `worldSlotCount(cols, rows)` uses the shared-corner formula documented in the contract tests.
2. `MainStreetState.streetGrid` supports the expanded grid (2D or flat world-indexed array with `gridCols/gridRows` metadata); existing 10-slot saves still load (migrated to 1×1 world grid) and `setupMainStreetGame()` with seed produces deterministic placement for 1×1.
3. `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` exposes `toWorldPosition`/`fromWorldPosition` and `expandedNeighbors` (or refactored `neighbors`) that handle shared corner slots — one slot ID serves up to four adjacent streets — and pass the contract tests for 2×1 / 2×2 fixtures.
4. `computeIncome`, `computeSynergyBonus`, `computeReputationPerTurn`, and `hasAdjacentSameType` consume the new resolver without changing their core formulas; spot-check on a 2×2 fixture with a shared-corner business matches hand-calculated totals.
5. `npm run build` and `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/` stay green; contract tests from slice 1 now pass.

## Minimal Implementation
- Refactor `MainStreetConstants.ts` / `MainStreetCards.ts` to derive `GRID_SIZE` from world dimensions; keep `GRID_SIZE=10` alias for 1×1.
- Introduce `src/main-street/GridTopology.ts` (or extend `MainStreetAdjacency.ts`) with world mapping and shared-corner dedup; reuse `Grid<T>` from `@core-engine/SpatialRules` where it reduces duplication.
- Update `MainStreetState.ts` shape (add `streetGridCols/Rows` or `worldGrid` + `camera`) with migration helper; wire `setupMainStreetGame` to new shape.
- Update `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` resolver and synergy/income call sites to use world positions.

## Dependencies
- Depends on: Expanded grid contract tests

## Deliverables
- Updated `MainStreetConstants.ts`, `MainStreetCards.ts`, `MainStreetState.ts`, `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` (+ new `GridTopology` helper if introduced)

## Key Files
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetConstants.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAdjacency.ts`
- `src/core-engine/SpatialRules.ts`
